timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹-5.64 Cr; net loss to shareholders ₹9.1 Cr (against a loss of ₹2.69 Cr a year earlier).

Ganges Securities Limited, Brij Mohan Agarwal, Shekhar Family Trust, Chandra Shekhar Nopany, and nine other entities submitted SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosures for SIL Investments Limited on April 2, 2026.
SIL Investments reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹39.53 Cr and PAT of ₹29.20 Cr, boosted by seasonal dividend income.
